resolution.doc:
regEffect registers a primitive from a per-round file. NEW ROUNDS MUST use
a dedicated backend/cards/registry_<topic>.go with

	func init() { regEffect("verb", Primitive{...}) }

instead of appending to the V2EffectRegistry literal above — tail-appends to
the literal are a recurring merge-conflict class (5 conflicts in one night,
2026-08-02, incl. brace-truncations and duplicated fields from marker-union
resolution). The literal is FROZEN; init() files never conflict.
Panics on duplicate so a bad merge fails the build instead of silently
shadowing an entry. (Package-level var init runs before any init(), so the
literal is always populated first.)
resolution.name: regEffect

280 type Card struct {
  281 	// Card characteristics (Rule 109.3)
  282 	ID   string   `json:"id"`
  283 	Name string   `json:"name"`
  284 	Type CardType `json:"type"`
  285 	// Types lists every primary type printed on the card (e.g. ["Artifact",
  286 	// "Creature"] for Hangarback Walker). Type stays the canonical primary
  287 	// for state-based-action and zone routing; Types lets effects like
  288 	// Retract ("all artifacts you control") see the full picture.
  289 	Types []string `json:"types,omitempty"`
  290 	// Legendary is true if this card carries the Legendary supertype (Rule 205.4d).
  291 	Legendary bool     `json:"legendary,omitempty"`
  292 	SubTypes  []string `json:"sub_types"`
  293 	ManaCost  ManaCost `json:"mana_cost"`
  294 	Colors    []Color  `json:"colors"`
  295 	// ColorIdentity is the Commander color identity (Rule 903.4).
  296 	ColorIdentity []Color `json:"color_identity,omitempty"`
  297 	// IsBasic marks the "Basic" land supertype (exempt from the singleton rule).
  298 	IsBasic bool `json:"is_basic,omitempty"`
  299 	// IsCommander marks a card designated as this player's commander; it starts
  300 	// in and is cast from the command zone and tracks commander tax.
  301 	IsCommander bool `json:"is_commander,omitempty"`
  302 	// CommanderCasts counts times this commander has been cast from the command
  303 	// zone this game (Rule 903.8 tax: {2} more per prior cast).
  304 	CommanderCasts int       `json:"commander_casts,omitempty"`
  305 	BasePower      *int      `json:"power,omitempty"`     // Base power for creatures
  306 	BaseToughness  *int      `json:"toughness,omitempty"` // Base toughness for creatures
  307 	Keywords       []Keyword `json:"keywords"`
  308 	// HasNonKeywordAbility records whether this card carries any ability
  309 	// other than a Rule 702 keyword ability (a triggered, activated, or
  310 	// non-keyword static ability). Keywords above covers Rule 702 entries
  311 	// (flying, protection, partner, haste, ...) exclusively, so this flag is
  312 	// the complement checked by the exile_creature_unless_keyword_only
  313 	// primitive (ticket engine.auto-exile-creature-unless-keyword-only-dc154f319f).
  314 	HasNonKeywordAbility bool                `json:"has_non_keyword_ability,omitempty"`
  315 	Protection           []ProtectionQuality `json:"protection,omitempty"` // Rule 702.16 - Protection
  316 	// ProtectionManaValueThreshold is N for a ProtectionFromManaValue entry in
  317 	// Protection above ("protection from mana value N or less"). Only
  318 	// meaningful when Protection contains ProtectionFromManaValue; see
  319 	// HasProtectionFromCard's ProtectionFromManaValue case.
  320 	ProtectionManaValueThreshold int `json:"protection_mana_value_threshold,omitempty"`
  321 	// ProtectionDynamicPredicate backs a ProtectionFromDynamicSet entry in
  322 	// Protection above ([VOCAB] #1104): "protection from permanents matching
  323 	// [live condition]" (e.g. "protection from creatures with a corruption
  324 	// counter on them"). Evaluated fresh against the source's CURRENT state
  325 	// on every HasProtectionFromCard call — not memoized/snapshotted at
  326 	// grant time — so a source gaining or losing the qualifying condition
  327 	// after the grant already exists is picked up automatically, without
  328 	// re-granting anything. Mirrors the func-field, non-serialized pattern
  329 	// of Card.CastRestrictionPredicate ([VOCAB] #18). Only meaningful when
  330 	// Protection contains ProtectionFromDynamicSet; only one predicate is
  331 	// tracked per card at a time (same single-value simplicity as
  332 	// ProtectionManaValueThreshold).
  333 	ProtectionDynamicPredicate func(source *Card) bool `json:"-"`
  334 	// HexproofFrom — Rule 702.11c: color-scoped Hexproof grants (e.g.
  335 	// "Hexproof from blue", "Hexproof from each color"). Distinct from the
  336 	// Hexproof keyword itself, which blocks ALL opponent targeting.
  337 	HexproofFrom []HexproofColorQuality `json:"hexproof_from,omitempty"`
  338 	// HexproofFromTypes — card-type-scoped hexproof, orthogonal to the color
  339 	// system above: "Hexproof from instants" (Elenda, Saint of Dusk) = can't be

effect/value pair is the shorthand for a one-atom sequence.

320 type EffectAtom struct {
  321 	Effect   string                 `json:"effect"`
  322 	Value    map[string]interface{} `json:"value,omitempty"`
  323 	Keyword  string                 `json:"keyword,omitempty"`
  324 	Affects  *TargetFilter          `json:"affects,omitempty"`
  325 	Target   *TargetFilter          `json:"target,omitempty"`
  326 	Link     string                 `json:"link,omitempty"` // then | if_you_do | if_you_dont | and
  327 	Optional bool                   `json:"optional,omitempty"`
  328 	Duration string                 `json:"duration,omitempty"` // until_end_of_turn | ...
  329 	Granted  *AbilityDSL            `json:"granted,omitempty"`  // Change 4: nested paragraph (grant_ability, tokens-with-text)
  330 	// Condition gates THIS atom specifically (parser-spine round 2026-08-09,
  331 	// docs/parser-spine-refactor.md item 3): a mid-sequence "intervening if"
  332 	// distinct from Link's if_you_do/if_you_dont (those key off a prior
  333 	// optional's accept/decline, not game state) — "Target creature gains
  334 	// protection... If it's a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it."
  335 	// (Angelic Intervention class) or the Court-of-Kaldheim "base effect /
  336 	// enhanced effect if you're the monarch, instead" pair (two atoms, same
  337 	// Condition, opposite Negate). Skipped entirely (never executed, no
  338 	// stack/target consumption) when the condition is false — the walker
  339 	// evaluates it via the same game.EvaluateCondition every static "as
  340 	// long as" and trigger intervening-if already use.
  341 	Condition *Condition `json:"condition,omitempty"`

  343 	// an atom with Effect=="modal"; each mode is itself an ordered atom
